metrics.label: Volume
metrics.gloss: the bar's traded volume, in base-asset units

metrics.label: Volume SMA (20)
metrics.gloss: 20-period average traded volume as published by the market data service, in base-asset units

metrics.label: Trades
metrics.gloss: the bar's total executed trade count

metrics.label: Buy volume
metrics.gloss: the bar's buy-side traded volume, in base-asset units

metrics.label: Sell volume
metrics.gloss: the bar's sell-side traded volume, in base-asset units

metrics.label: Quote volume
metrics.gloss: the bar's traded notional, in USD: the sum of each trade's price × size from the live tape; absent for a bar holding a minute the live tape did not cover, never zero

metrics.label: Buy quote volume
metrics.gloss: the bar's buy-side traded notional, in USD: the sum of each taker buy's price × size from the live tape; absent for a bar holding a minute the live tape did not cover, never zero

metrics.label: Sell quote volume
metrics.gloss: the bar's sell-side traded notional, in USD: the sum of each taker sell's price × size from the live tape; absent for a bar holding a minute the live tape did not cover, never zero

metrics.label: Notional volume (24h)
metrics.gloss: 24-hour traded notional volume, USD

metrics.label: RVOL (relative volume)
metrics.gloss: relative volume — the bar’s volume divided by its 20-period average, as a multiple (1.0 = at baseline, 2.0 = twice baseline)

metrics.label: OBV (offset arbitrary)
metrics.gloss: on-balance volume — the running sum of sign(Δclose) × volume from the first bar this column reads, in base-asset units; its level is arbitrary, so read its change, slope or trend, which agree with TradingView’s OBV

metrics.label: CMF (20)
metrics.gloss: 20-period Chaikin money flow — each bar's volume weighted by where it closed in its range (−1 at the low, +1 at the high, 0 on a flat bar), summed over the 20 bars ending at this bar and divided by their volume; no value when that volume is zero

metrics.label: Order-flow CVD (UTC day)
metrics.gloss: order-flow cumulative volume delta — taker buy minus taker sell volume from the trade tape, accumulated since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor

metrics.label: Cumulative Volume Delta (UTC day)
metrics.gloss: TradingView's cumulative volume delta — each intrabar's volume signed by its close against its open, then against the previous intrabar's close, summed since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor; intrabars are 1m on minute and hour rungs and 5m on 1d

metrics.label: Order-flow spot CVD (composite, UTC day)
metrics.gloss: order-flow composite centralized-exchange spot cumulative volume delta at each bar, the listed venues that publish their trade history (Binance, Coinbase) summed through the bar's last minute since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor, in this coin's own unit (crypto coins the spot lane lists)

metrics.label: Buy pressure
metrics.gloss: buy share of traded volume (0–1)

metrics.label: Buy pressure (Coinbase)
metrics.gloss: buy share of Coinbase's spot volume in the bar's period (0–1), from the venue's taker sides

metrics.label: Buy pressure (Binance)
metrics.gloss: buy share of Binance's spot volume in the bar's period (0–1), from the venue's taker sides

metrics.label: Spot avg trade
metrics.gloss: the composite spot volume per trade in the bar's period, over the listed venues that publish their trade history (Binance, Coinbase), in this coin's own unit; absent where one of those venues did not cover the period or nothing traded

metrics.label: Spot dominance
metrics.gloss: the composite spot volume, over the listed venues that publish their trade history (Binance, Coinbase), as a share of composite spot plus the bar's perp volume, both in this coin's own unit (0–1); absent where one of those venues did not cover the period

metrics.label: Buy trades
metrics.gloss: the bar's buy trade count

metrics.label: Sell trades
metrics.gloss: the bar's sell trade count

studies.label: Bar volume
studies.gloss: the bar's traded volume and its buy and sell halves, in base-asset units

studies.label: Bar trades
studies.gloss: the bar's executed trade count and its buy and sell halves

studies.label: Relative volume (20)
studies.gloss: the bar's volume against its 20-period average

studies.label: Spot flow
studies.gloss: the order flow of the listed venues that publish their trade history (Binance, Coinbase) at the bar — each such venue's buy share, and the composite's average trade, its share of spot plus perp volume and its UTC-day cumulative delta, in this coin's own unit

indicators.label: Bar volume
indicators.gloss: the bar's traded volume and its buy and sell halves, in base-asset units

indicators.label: Volume MA / RVOL
indicators.gloss: the simple average of the bar's volume over the chosen number of bars, or the bar's volume against that average

indicators.label: Bar trades
indicators.gloss: the bar's executed trade count and its buy and sell halves

indicators.label: OBV (offset arbitrary)
indicators.gloss: on-balance volume — the running sum of sign(Δclose) × volume from the first bar this column reads, in base-asset units; its level is arbitrary, so read its change, slope or trend, which agree with TradingView’s OBV

indicators.label: CMF (20)
indicators.gloss: 20-period Chaikin money flow — each bar's volume weighted by where it closed in its range (−1 at the low, +1 at the high, 0 on a flat bar), summed over the 20 bars ending at this bar and divided by their volume; no value when that volume is zero

indicators.label: Order-flow CVD (UTC day)
indicators.gloss: order-flow cumulative volume delta — taker buy minus taker sell volume from the trade tape, accumulated since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor

indicators.label: Cumulative Volume Delta (UTC day)
indicators.gloss: TradingView's cumulative volume delta — each intrabar's volume signed by its close against its open, then against the previous intrabar's close, summed since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor; intrabars are 1m on minute and hour rungs and 5m on 1d

indicators.label: Spot flow
indicators.gloss: the order flow of the listed venues that publish their trade history (Binance, Coinbase) at the bar — each such venue's buy share, and the composite's average trade, its share of spot plus perp volume and its UTC-day cumulative delta, in this coin's own unit

templates.title: Momentum Composite
templates.description: RSI, MACD, and Stochastic %K read at the section anchor — a one-glance momentum panel.

templates.title: Volatility & Trend
templates.description: ATR, ADX, and Bollinger width % at the section anchor — regime and expansion at a glance.

templates.title: Venue Dislocation
templates.description: Where the spot venues and the perp disagree at the section anchor — the Coinbase premium over Binance, the perp basis over each venue, the cross-venue buy-share gap, and the composite spot tape.

share of the field’s directional picks that are up (%); absent when no bias has been measured
the direction the field leans, derived from the share; absent whenever the bias is, and at an exact 50/50 where no side dominates
share of captain picks landing on the single most-captained coin (%)
